messages.subject: Project Juniper - advice on Wexbourne mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Gordon, Lesley,

Advice note attached on the main points in Wexbourne's mark-up. In short, we recommend: counter the liability cap at 137.5% (~£5.375m Yr1); accept the goods-liability change provided we confirm the £8m goods-in-trust cover and add a non-vitiation endorsement in Wexbourne's favour; accept 6-month convenience notice but seek recovery of unamortised mobilisation costs on early exit; counter indexation at 3.5%.

Happy to talk it through. We'd like to send our v3 by early next week.

Best,
James

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
